'''Dazopus''' is a [[Water]] type [[DPS]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves from [[Dumbopus]] at 6 bronze stars, and evolves into [[Fishopus]] at 18 stars after completing their specific [[trials|evolution trials]].

==Overview==
Current Description: "Sometimes, even Dazopus can't explain the strange thoughts that come to mind. I guess that's what you call a walking contradiction."

Dazopus is a gold rarity Tatari.

==Appearance==
A cyan octopus with an orange and yellow fish in its head. The ends of its tentacles are purple, and its eyes are googly-like.

Dazopus's [[Tatari#Glitter_Tataris|Glitter]] form changes the orange fish into pink.

== Evolution Trial ==
Dazopus's evolution trial unlocks once it reaches 18 stars. To evolve it into [[Fishopus]] you need to complete the following two tasks:

* Feed Dazopus to increase stats 3 times.
* Play [[Fishing Contest]] (use Fishing Rod x2000) or [[Zobo Shooter]] (use Bullet Coin x400,000).
